one_liner: Grain (grain.com) has a documented REST public API with free-plan Personal Access Tokens, OAuth2 auth-code+PKCE, webhooks, and an official remote MCP server.
auth_notes: Bearer tokens: PAT (free, all plans), WAT (Business/Enterprise, admin), and OAuth2 authorization code flow with PKCE for integrations distributed to any Grain user. The fetched pages do not show whether OAuth app registration is self-serve; an earlier Nango note (not in current pages) suggested limited developer access, so PAT is the safe path for testing.
access_notes: Official Grain support article states personal API access is available on every plan including Free, so a builder can get working credentials self-serve. Workspace tokens need Business/Enterprise.
blocker_notes: PATs are free and self-serve, so testing can start now. Minor uncertainty on whether OAuth app registration is self-serve.

evidence.quote: **Personal Access Token (PAT)**: grants access on behalf of a single user.
**OAuth2**: the standard flow for building integrations to be used by any Grain user.
Available on every plan, including Free.
The Grain API lets you read and manage recordings, highlights, uploads, and more.
Webhooks let Grain push data to your system when events occur, rather than requiring you to poll for changes.
Grain's official MCP server is available now for all users!
Grain's MCP server is officially supported by us and aligns with our existing security practices
